note: What a player agrees to at checkout for a coin pack (withdrawal, terms, stripeSubmit), a credit pack (creditsWithdrawal, terms, creditsStripeSubmit) or the season pass (passWithdrawal, terms, passStripeSubmit; bought in its pre-sale, before the season starts: passPreSaleWithdrawal and passPreSaleStripeSubmit, {activates} being the season's first day, e.g. "1 December"); "Remind me when sales open" on the pass page (reminderVisitor, reminderPlayer, reminderPlayerEmail; stored with each reminder). The server stores this exact text with each payment (payments.consent_text), so change `version` whenever the wording changes.
withdrawal: I want my coins delivered right away. I understand that I lose my 14-day right of withdrawal once they're delivered.
terms: I'm 18 or older, or a parent or guardian has agreed to this purchase. I accept the terms of sale.
stripeSubmit: By paying you ask for your coins to be delivered right away and agree that your 14-day right of withdrawal ends once they're delivered.
passWithdrawal: I want my pass delivered right away. I understand that I lose my 14-day right of withdrawal once it's delivered.
passStripeSubmit: By paying you ask for your pass to be delivered right away and agree that your 14-day right of withdrawal ends once it's delivered.
passPreSaleWithdrawal: I want my pass to activate on {activates}. Until then I can cancel it for a full refund; once it activates, my 14-day right of withdrawal ends.
reminderVisitor: Email me once at this address when the {pass} goes on sale on {opens}. I'll first get an email to confirm my address; only a confirmed address gets the reminder. No newsletter, and I can cancel it any time.
reminderPlayerEmail: Also email me once at {email} when it goes on sale (I'll confirm the address from an email first).
reminderPlayer: Remind me in the game when the {pass} goes on sale on {opens}.
passPreSaleStripeSubmit: Your pass activates on {activates}. Until then you can cancel it for a full refund; once it activates, your 14-day right of withdrawal ends.
creditsWithdrawal: I want my credits delivered right away. I understand that I lose my 14-day right of withdrawal once they're delivered.
creditsStripeSubmit: By paying you ask for your credits to be delivered right away and agree that your 14-day right of withdrawal ends once they're delivered.
